notes.title: Balance Update 1: Steep Slopes version 0.0.3
notes.content: We noticed that it was easy for players to abuse hopping around to get a high score, and it was almost never worth grinding for a player. So we tweaked the points received for different tricks to incentive player's to have a more diverse play-style. so in summary the [b][u]points received for hopping was nerfed[/u] (from 3 to 2)[/b], [b][u]grinding received a major buff[/u] (from 1 to 4)[/b], and [b][u]launching off a ramp received a minor buff[/u] (from 10 to 12).[/b]
